comparison.objective: Push a hose onto a valve barb, position a clamp, and proof-lift the assembly.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterhold a valve, force-fit a hose, slide a clamp, and conduct a lift check.
comparison.success_condition: Hose overlaps the barb by at least 2 cm, clamp covers it, and the released assembly passes a lift demonstration.
comparison.reason: It tests interference-fit assembly and clamp placement, not setting an adjustable stop against locknut torque.
